title: Say what kind of computer this is
callouts: The column now says whether one person or many have signed in on this computer, from the rows the read already returns.
A person who can no longer sign in is no longer offered: the read filters on the account being active, as the other two account reads do.
Sign-in itself is unchanged: the name is still typed or picked, and the PIN is still required.

elements.design: The line under the offer heading that states how many people use this computer
elements.note: three new properties, one per band: one person, several, six or more

elements.design: The three wordings the line can show
elements.note: new keys; the heading keeps Startup_SignIn.PreviousPeopleHeading

elements.design: The offer itself: one card per person
elements.winui: ItemsControl with a Button per item

elements.design: The divider and the offer column
elements.winui: Border width 1 and a ScrollViewer, MaxWidth 300
elements.note: unchanged: still shown only while the read answered with people
adds the u.is_active = 1 filter the other two account reads already carry

elements.note: the read caps at six, so fewer than six is exact and six means six or more
